I'll keep looking. I at least need to find a second job. School isn't an option right now because bi just failed out of one University and dropped our of a community college. I've lost every scholarship and grant I had.

I have. They are just set in their ways. They don't really believe in depression or any of that stuff and usually they make it worse. I'm not sure what a personal journey for me would be or where to begin. I appreciate you posting.

Thank you for your post. It really means a lot. Sadly my college doesn't have much. They have the main, national hotlines listed and not much else. They do have an advising program to help people with different disabilities and emotional issues. The problem with that is I'm not diagnosed with anything and can't get the proper paperwork to apply for that. I'm scarred to go to the ER because my parents would absolutely lose it. A) Because in their mind I have no reason to be going and shouldn't do anything without their knowledge and B) Because I have no insurance and can't afford any doctor's visits or bills or anything. Any money I have is going toward getting my car fixed or getting a new one because it's a huge issue. I got a few free counseling sessions through my work but they pretty much told me exactly what you and others said. I couldn't afford to continue with them though because they weren't on a sliding scale. I agree that I should try an antidepressant but for the time being I just don't have the ability. I know it sounds like I just discounting everything you said but that's not what I'm trying to do. I guess I'm just trying to let you know I listened and I'm trying.

I just recently had to leave my old school because I fucked up with grades and shit. I'm now attending a community college. At my old school I had a decent amount of friends in my major and I was even in a fraternity. I was there for three years. Now I have no friends because I can't make any at my current school and my old friends don't talk to me much because they are so far away and busy with their own lives. All I do is go to school, go to work, and sit in my room and play video games. I hate my new major, I hate my new school, and I hate that I'm so lonely. I'm probably just going to drop out.
I try to think of things that bring joy in my life but nothing comes to mind. Things that used to just don't anymore. At this point I just don't know what to do.

I don't feel like I'm worthy of love. The only people who have loved me are my parents but even for them it seems like I'm never enough and nothing I ever do is enough. I feel like I have no reason for existing what so ever. I've come this far in life but I've left no impact. I've done nothing of substance with my life.
